responsibility: This Python module provides GDB pretty-printers, helper commands, and GCC-specific debugging utilities for live compiler processes. It decodes and formats core GCC data structures such as trees, RTL, basic blocks, edges, cgraph nodes, and vectors; adds workflow commands like break-on-pass, dump-fn, and dot-fn; and is loaded from the build-tree .gdbinit to improve interactive debugging of GCC internals.
